# Sultan Mauritius

> Official distributor of Sultan mineral water in Mauritius: sparkling
> flavoured mineral water in 200ml glass bottles (11 flavours) and still
> spring water in 250ml/500ml/1.5L PET bottles, sourced from Turkey,
> family-owned since the 1960s, on Mauritian tables since March
> 2021. Sells to both individual consumers (B2C) and businesses such as
> restaurants, supermarkets, and wholesalers (B2B). No online payment:
> orders are settled by bank transfer or cash on delivery.

The site is bilingual: English at `/en`, French at `/fr`.

## Pages

- [Shop](https://sultanmauritius.com/en/products): the full sparkling and still product range, with B2C and wholesale pricing.
- [About](https://sultanmauritius.com/en/about): company history and water quality data.
- [Wholesale](https://sultanmauritius.com/en/wholesale): B2B account setup for restaurants, shops, and events.
- [Stockists](https://sultanmauritius.com/en/stockists): where to buy in stores across Mauritius.
- [Contact](https://sultanmauritius.com/en/contact): general enquiries.
